title: The Flying Friends of Strawberry Island
summary: Dimitar, a young flying dragonet, enjoys a busy day at school on Circular Island. After a lunch of fish crackers and a restful nap with his purple cat stuffie, Sanina, he heads outside for playground time. While his other friends are grounded, he meets Zudy, a red and green dragonet visiting from Strawberry Island. The two take to the skies for a dizzying aerial display before their mothers, Allego and Demora, meet to arrange a cross-island playdate.

characters.name: Dimitar
characters.description: A sharp-witted resident of a circular island castle, this two-century-old purple dragonet carries a pirate’s salt-crusted legacy and a fierce devotion to his salvaged library. Formerly of the Cadasori galleries, Seeker’s grumpy companion now roams the deep to save his ancestral shores, though a recent volcanic disturbance has left him uncharacteristically sickened and frail. Driven by habit and a tireless appetite for fish, he bickers incessantly over snacks while guarding his remaining volumes with a brooding, protective intensity.

characters.name: Alexander
characters.description: A poised driver and student at Ginger Catasorry, this feline friend to Dimitar and Scratch Cat manages a digital Tamagotchi empire from the confines of a lunchbox. After recently representing Silver during the playdate, their steady paw was led far from the morning commute into the treacherous depths of the dark forest, where they navigated the shadows alongside Jane.

characters.name: Jane
characters.description: Dimitar’s matronly childhood companion is a kindhearted cat and daring ship’s pilot, a friend to Finn, Isabella, and Scratch Cat who navigates the expedition toward Mouse Castle and the road to Cadasori. Her cockpit is a warm sanctuary distinguished by a "love you" sticker and a cabin teeming with whiskered passengers, reflecting the same tenderness she first offered Silver. Though she maintains a bold pace, she is easily swayed by snacks at Seeker’s house or waylaid within the tangled depths of the dark forest. An adventurous spirit with whimsical desires, she currently dreams of a special little hat adorned with rainbow feathers, glitter, and a miniature fishy pond to crown her nautical ensemble.

characters.name: Ginger
characters.description: A soft, round, and silver-coated feline, this exceptionally fluffy educator is one of Minnie and Mickey’s own kittens grown into a figure of quiet authority. Known for daintily distributing napkins with velvet paws and commuting to school behind the wheel, the gray-furred teacher balances his role on Nana’s welcoming committee with a life of polite, helpful service. Whether presiding over his humble sanctuary—the very cage Seeker once coveted—or sustaining himself on crunchy kibble and savory wet food, he remains a steady presence, most recently seen trading his classroom duties for the shadows of a secret closet hideout alongside Garfield.

characters.name: The Teacher
characters.description: The educator at Dimitar's school who watches the children play and gets dizzy from the dragons' flying.

characters.name: Sanina
characters.description: Dimitar's soft, purple cat stuffie used for nap time.

characters.name: Zudy Dragon
characters.description: A red and green dragonet from Strawberry Island who meets Dimitar on the playground.

characters.name: Dimitar's Mother
characters.description: Dimitar's mother who flies him to school.

places.name: Circular Island
places.description: A perfectly circular landmass rising from the waters of the distant reaches, this remote sanctuary serves as both the private residence of Dimitar and the hallowed grounds of the school.

places.name: Strawberry Island
places.description: The home of Zudy Dragon, known for having strawberries for every meal.

places.name: The School Playground
places.description: The place where Dimitar and Zudy first meet and fly together.
